perspective:
Cynthia’s available information:

- She teaches evening classes at the community center and works with Christina, who is involved in marketing there.
- In the staff meeting, Cynthia argued that traditional classes should be highlighted in the next campaign because they are the backbone of past success and appeal to the core audience’s desire for structure and depth.
- She heard Christina say there is strong interest in more dynamic, interactive sessions; that they should showcase innovation; and that they could balance old and new rather than replace what works.
- Cynthia remained unconvinced at that meeting and said marketing should play to their traditional strengths.
- Later, Cynthia saw positive feedback from Christina’s innovative campaign. She approached Christina and heard Christina explain that she used interactive elements and social media to create conversation, not just broadcast information. Christina also said new and old methods can blend and that they can learn from each other.
- Cynthia found Christina’s explanation intriguing and recognized that Christina seemed to capture both depth and flash.
- Cynthia proposed a pilot project combining traditional lectures with interactive online sessions. Christina liked the idea and agreed to test how the methods blend. Cynthia hoped it would enhance learning and draw a wider audience. They agreed to outline specifics and implementation.
- The pilot succeeded. Cynthia told Christina it was a hit and wanted to scale it up immediately, saying she would organize resources and set up a schedule.
- She heard Christina say she would coordinate with the marketing team to spread the word. Cynthia was excited and expected a big impact. They agreed to keep momentum going.
- After the blended methods were implemented, Cynthia received overwhelmingly positive feedback. She planned a presentation to showcase the project’s success and advocate expanding it to other centers.
- She heard Christina offer help and say other centers could benefit. Cynthia said she was proud and that blending their methods was the right move. Christina said it had been a pleasure seeing their ideas come to life successfully.
